title: System Design Interview
description: Scale from zero to millions of users, then design rate limiters, chat systems, YouTube, payment systems, stock exchanges and more.

title: Coding Interview Patterns
description: Nineteen problem-solving patterns, from two pointers to dynamic programming, with solutions in multiple languages.

title: Object-Oriented Design Interview
description: A framework for OOD interviews plus parking lots, elevators, vending machines, ATMs and other classic class-design problems.

title: Machine Learning System Design Interview
description: End-to-end ML systems: visual search, recommendations, harmful content detection, ad click prediction and news feeds.

title: Generative AI System Design Interview
description: Smart compose, translation, chatbots, RAG, image synthesis and text-to-video generation, designed from first principles.

title: Mobile System Design Interview
description: A framework for mobile interviews plus news feed, chat, stock trading, Google Drive and YouTube apps.
